result_text:
`all_files.zip` is now built from the aspect names the loose files were written under, so a renamed scope aspect no longer breaks the export.

**Change:** `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`, in `exportJson()`. The five hardcoded `aspect_*.txt` literals are replaced by a loop over the main, test, generated, build-and-deploy and other aspects, in that order. Each entry name comes from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same call used when writing the loose files, and the content is read from that same file. The `git-history.zip` block is unchanged.

**Verification:** `mvn -o -pl reports test-compile` and `mvn -o -pl reports test` both succeed. The reports module has no test covering this export, so I did not run a renamed-aspect export end to end. With the default config the entries resolve to the same five names in the same order as before.

**Not changed:** `LandscapeAnalyzer.getRepositoryFiles()` (`codeanalyzer/.../LandscapeAnalyzer.java`, around lines 280–284) still hardcodes the five `aspect_*.txt` names. It has the same problem for a renamed aspect, but it is a separate code path, so I left it alone. Say if you want it fixed too.

Nothing is committed.
